notes: Form N-14 (filed February 19, 2021) carrying a Combined Prospectus/Information Statement for the reorganization of Matthews Emerging Asia Fund (Target Fund) into Matthews Asia Small Companies Fund (Acquiring Fund), both series of Matthews International Funds d/b/a Matthews Asia Funds, an open-end management investment company (mutual funds); kind is merger per the open-end reorganisation rule. No shareholder vote: the filing states the reorganization may be effected without shareholder approval under Rule 17a-8, so shareholder_approval is not a condition and meeting_date/record_date are null. The Acquiring Fund's new name is given inconsistently in the filing ('Matthews Emerging Markets Small Companies Fund' in the letter and body, 'Matthews Emerging Markets Small Cap Fund' on the cover of the Combined Prospectus/Information Statement); acquirer is recorded under its current name. No exchange tickers are printed in the excerpt. Exchange is NAV-for-NAV, same class for same class; no fixed ratio, cash or collar stated. security_class: the registered securities are 'Shares of beneficial interest' (Institutional Class and Investor Class); recorded as common, uncertain. Conditions: 'other' covers the bring-down of representations, warranties and covenants (the condition that the Target Fund declare a dividend distributing all undistributed net investment income and net capital gains is a further 'other'-type condition). No outside/termination date: the agreement may be terminated or amended by mutual consent of the Trust. Expected close is stated as 'on or about April 29, 2021'; the Acquiring Fund name change is expected on or about April 30, 2021. The Board approved the Reorganization at a meeting held on February 12, 2021.
